input.body:
label: bug
file: src/export/csv.ts

The issue describes a bug where transactions with the same date, amount, and description but different currencies are being merged incorrectly in the CSV export. This suggests the merging logic in the CSV writer does not account for currency differences, causing data loss. The reporter notes this only became apparent after version 3.2.0, when transactions started carrying currency information.

input.title: Prevent CSV rows with same date, amount, and description from merging when currencies differ
input.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The CSV writer currently merges rows that share the same date, amount, and description, even when their currencies differ. This causes transactions with identical metadata except for currency to be lost in the exported CSV. The fix should ensure that rows are treated as distinct if their currency fields differ, preserving all transactions in the output.

The CSV writer currently merges rows that share the same date, amount, and description, even when their currencies differ.
